checks.criterion: Pinned official release, selected original tasks and untouched labels
Same 3 tasks × 3 stages × 3 methods; single repeat disclosed
TOOL/PARAM/DESC and an unaffected retention task documented
Real MCP catalogs and behavior match the reviewed archived release
Same agent model, decoding, tasks, judge protocol and execution code
Every No Update snapshot exactly equals Early knowledge
Every evolved Full Rewrite regenerates all tool descriptions and rebuilds complete structural metadata
Only affected records updated; unchanged records preserved; routing/schema validation passes
All dispatched runtime calls originate in LLM responses
All 27 scheduled cells attempted with honest completion/failure status
Five valid original-rubric ratings per trajectory; any incomplete cell excluded without replacement
TF/PE/ECS for all three methods from matched eligible comparisons
Changed/unaffected performance changes reported, including adverse results
Tokens/time/API charges recorded for all methods; unknown costs remain unknown
Commands/config/raw logs archived; offline recomputation and idempotent resume verified
At least one real trajectory with causal stale-knowledge evidence; identify the responsible method
At least one real trajectory showing unrelated knowledge rewrite damaged prior working behavior; low score alone is insufficient
Submission-ready report with results, both failure categories and discussion
10-minute presentation and 5-minute Q&A preparation
Dedicated user-selected site and actual draft publication verified

interpretation: Readiness checks are not a requirement for every agent task to succeed. Preserve failures, missingness and unfavorable scores. No tuning during this frozen trial.
